_why: David retired the US State Department as a safety authority on 2026-08-18. Traveller-facing prose still cites it in this many places. The number may only go DOWN. It is a ratchet, not a target: erroring on all of them would paint validate:ingest red until 157 dossiers are rewritten by hand, and a permanently red gate is one people learn to pass with --no-verify. Lower this number as the claims are rewritten; the gate refuses any increase.
_rewritten_by: a human reading the FCDO, never a script. The alternative is what put a sentence State never wrote into a Cartagena consent screen.
_promise_note: Safety promises are ABSOLUTE — target 0, not a tolerance. Ratcheted only so a pre-existing set does not block unrelated work. Remedy is deletion of the claim, never a generated replacement.
_advisory_text_note: Hazards attributed to an advisory that does not name them, in FAQ answers. Target 0. Ratcheted only so a pre-existing set does not block unrelated work; a human rewrites from the source text or drops the claim.
_forbidden_question_note: A faq question asking whether a place is safe (David, 2026-08-19). Target 0 and then a hard fail. Ratcheted only until the research library batch that removes ours lands. Delete the whole pair, never the answer alone, and never leave a row with an empty faq.
_ratcheted: 2026-08-27 — David ruled on the last of each: activity-guidance sentences re-worded to drop the word entirely (his approved phrasing), the country-safety superlative deleted outright, the one activity question re-worded to keep its answer. Both classes are now at their target of ZERO and a single recurrence fails the gate.
_widened_2026_08_25: The counter walked safety.* and faq[].a only; the dive-group incident measured what that missed (29 mentions in booking, 13 in key_facts, more in orbit/timing — invisible to the number everyone quoted as the total). The walk now covers every string in the dossier body, and the ratchet restarts at the honest 395. This is a SCOPE widening, not a regression: the old 97 and the new 395 count different things, and 97-of-two-fields was a smaller claim than anyone reading it believed. Shrink from here; the gate refuses any growth.
